notes.title: Dev Diary 30/10/2022
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43018326/00ec92764a4d83b9706893d32663d209e9a6325b.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello Everybody,[/b]
My name is Adam Szczecina and I would like to take this opportunity to welcome you to our “Dork” community 😊. Four years ago I’ve received a phone call from my dear friend Tomek Namiota (brilliante programmer and automation engineer) to ask if I would be interested in creating the graphics for a simple game that would take no more then six months to complete. Immediately I’ve said Yes! We had no idea what we are getting our selves into! With no previous experience in game development on both sides we sat down to work. Quickly it transformed from a pixel graphic idea to something much more, and eventually grew to an epic proportion. Working outside our normal jobs we have, many times, clashed and pulled our beards off but guided by our love for gaming, film and imagination we have finished our first game. And here it is. We hope you will enjoy it!

We are fully committed to further development of our “baby” so any feedback is extremely welcome. Keep a watch for any news and gameplay, something might be coming soon 😊 

All the Best,
Adam
